studyPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target ONLY LOWER HALF of supplied poster. Output ONE standalone landscape 4:3 frame showing the lower-half artwork only, at maximum available resolution. Preserve the actual artwork: original skyline left, large warm coral and blue cargo ship right, pale sky-blue/cream shell pieces behind skyline, water fragments underneath, irregular dissolving outer boundary on clean warm white textured paper. Keep this an arranged material collage occupying about 60–70% of the frame footprint with breathing paper margins, asymmetric negative space and missing/disconnected/floating modules. DO NOT turn it into an edge-to-edge landscape with a uniform mosaic overlay. Preserve source recognizability and selective structural detail, square-module foundation plus shaped small shell fragments for ship masts/rigging. Chalky matte mineral-shell layers with subtly chipped edges and shallow relief, luminous pale blue/teal, butter yellow, coral accents; no dirty gray, dark earth tones, plastic, glossy pearlescence. This is a later animation frame: ONLY a tiny ripple interrupts the orange reflection below the cargo ship, a few water fragments gently separate then drift nearby. All architecture and boat fixed. No added person or character, no new objects, no photo upper half, no type or text. Treat the source lower-half collage as the finished artwork to preserve, not merely a theme to redraw.
